onboarding.subtitle: To get started, choose a transcription model

parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.name: Parakeet V2
parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.description: English only. The best model for English speakers.

moonshine-base.name: Moonshine Base
moonshine-base.description: Very fast, English only. Handles accents well.

moonshine-small-streaming-en.name: Moonshine V2 Small
moonshine-small-streaming-en.description: Fast, English only. Good balance of speed and accuracy.

breeze-asr.name: Breeze ASR
breeze-asr.description: Optimized for Taiwanese Mandarin. Code-switching support.

sense-voice-int8.name: SenseVoice
sense-voice-int8.description: Very fast. Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Cantonese.

gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.name: GigaAM v3
gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.description: Russian speech recognition. Fast and accurate.

canary-180m-flash.name: Canary 180M Flash
canary-180m-flash.description: Very fast. English, German, Spanish, French. Supports translation.

canary-1b-v2.name: Canary 1B v2
canary-1b-v2.description: Accurate multilingual. 25 European languages. Supports translation.

cohere-int8.name: Cohere
cohere-int8.description: A large, slower, but very accurate multilingual model.

style.title: Choose your Style
style.subtitle: Nova can automatically adapt the Style to the active app, or always use the same one.

auto.title: Automatic
auto.description: Nova detects the active app and picks the most fitting Style for you.

manual.title: One specific Style
manual.description: Nova always applies the same Style, whatever the app.

errors.save: Failed to save the selected Style. You can change it later in settings.

variables.title: Add your personal shortcuts
variables.subtitle: Link a keyword to something you dictate often — Nova inserts the exact value while reformulating. You can always edit these later in settings.
variables.hint: Optional — leave blank to skip. Nothing is stored unless you fill in a value.

errors.save: Failed to save your shortcuts. You can add them later in settings.

tutorial.title: Try Nova
tutorial.subtitle: A quick test to see Nova at work before you finish.
tutorial.instructionsPushToTalk: Hold {{shortcut}} while you speak, then release.
tutorial.instructionsToggle: Press {{shortcut}} to start, speak, then press it again to stop.
tutorial.hint: You can try again as many times as you like.

permissions.title: Permissions Required
permissions.description: Nova needs a couple of permissions to work properly.

microphone.title: Microphone Access
microphone.description: Required to hear your voice for transcription.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Access
accessibility.description: Required to type transcribed text into your applications.

errors.checkFailed: Failed to check permissions. Please try again.
errors.requestFailed: Failed to request permission. Please try again.

capabilities.streaming: Shows live transcription as you speak

shortcut.title: Nova Shortcuts
shortcut.description: Configure keyboard shortcuts to trigger speech-to-text recording

transcribe.name: Transcribe Shortcut
transcribe.description: The keyboard shortcut to record and transcribe your voice.

cancel.name: Cancel Shortcut
cancel.description: The keyboard shortcut to cancel the current recording.

transcribe_with_post_process.name: Dictation with Style
transcribe_with_post_process.description: Records and applies the selected Style, even when reformulation is turned off.

errors.reset: Failed to reset shortcut to original value

language.title: Language
language.description: Select the language for speech recognition. Auto will automatically determine the language, while selecting a specific language can improve accuracy for that language.

pushToTalk.label: Push To Talk
pushToTalk.description: Hold to record, release to stop

models.title: Transcription Performance
models.description: Choose the accuracy/speed balance for transcription, or download additional options. Higher-accuracy options ask more of your device.
models.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{modelName}}? You will need to download it again to use it.
models.deleteActiveConfirm: {{modelName}} is your active model. Deleting it will stop transcriptions until you select a new model. Are you sure?

rescan.label: Rescan
rescan.tooltip: Rescan for models added to the models folder or Hugging Face cache outside Nova

audioFeedback.label: Audio Feedback
audioFeedback.description: Play sound when recording starts and stops

outputDevice.title: Output Device
outputDevice.description: Select your preferred audio output device for feedback sounds

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Adjust the volume of audio feedback sounds

experimentalToggle.label: Experimental Features
experimentalToggle.description: Enable experimental features that are still in development.

lazyStreamClose.label: Keep Mic Open Between Transcriptions
lazyStreamClose.description: Keeps the microphone stream open for 30 seconds after recording stops, reducing latency for back-to-back transcriptions. May degrade Bluetooth audio quality while active.

cpuOnly.title: CPU-only mode
cpuOnly.description: The graphics driver hung on a previous launch, so GPU acceleration was disabled. After updating your driver, retry the GPU — it takes effect on the next app start.

transcribe.title: transcribe.cpp Acceleration
transcribe.description: Hardware acceleration for transcribe.cpp (Whisper-family) models. Auto uses GPU if available (Metal on macOS, Vulkan on Windows/Linux).

ort.title: ONNX Acceleration
ort.description: Hardware acceleration for ONNX models (Parakeet, Canary, Moonshine, etc.). DirectML on Windows is experimental. Models may fail to transcribe.

startHidden.label: Start Hidden
startHidden.description: Launch to system tray without opening the window.

autostart.label: Launch on Startup
autostart.description: Automatically start Nova when you log in to your computer.

showTrayIcon.label: Show Tray Icon
showTrayIcon.description: Display the Nova icon in the system tray.

style.title: Overlay
style.description: Choose the recording overlay: None hides it, Minimal shows a compact pill, Live shows transcription in real time as you speak (streaming-capable models only — look for the Streaming badge in the model picker). On Linux 'None' is recommended.

position.title: Overlay Position
position.description: Where the overlay appears on screen during recording and transcription.

pasteMethod.title: Paste Method
pasteMethod.description: Choose how text is inserted. Direct: simulates typing via system input. None: skips paste, only updates history/clipboard.

typingTool.title: Typing Tool
typingTool.description: Choose which Linux typing tool to use for Direct paste method. Auto will automatically detect and use the best available tool for your system.

clipboardHandling.title: Clipboard Handling
clipboardHandling.description: Don't Modify Clipboard preserves your current clipboard contents after transcription. Copy to Clipboard leaves the transcription result in your clipboard after pasting.

autoSubmit.title: Auto Submit
autoSubmit.description: Automatically send the selected key combination after text insertion. Cmd+Enter applies on macOS, while Windows/Linux use Super+Enter.

translateToEnglish.label: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.description: Automatically translate speech from other languages to English during transcription.

modelUnload.title: Unload Model
modelUnload.description: Automatically free GPU/CPU memory when the model hasn't been used for the specified time

customWords.title: Personal Lexicon
customWords.description: Add words and multi-word terms (brand names, proper nouns, technical terms like "repo GitHub") that are often misheard or misspelled. Nova corrects similar-sounding speech to match your list and keeps these terms intact while rewriting.

voiceActivityDetection.title: Voice Activity Detection
voiceActivityDetection.description: Filter silence from recordings. Streaming-capable models use a longer VAD tail; disabling VAD records raw audio.

appleIntelligence.unavailable: Apple Intelligence is not available on this device. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS Tahoe (26.0) or later with Apple Intelligence enabled in System Settings.

turbo.managed: Turbo is managed by Nova: your license acts as the key, no configuration needed.
turbo.confirmDescription: Turbo sends your dictation to Nova to rewrite it online — a bit less private than Intelligence privée, which stays fully local. You can switch back to Intelligence privée anytime.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: API base URL for the selected provider. Only the custom provider can be edited.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider.

model.title: Model
model.descriptionCustom: Provide the model identifier expected by your custom endpoint.
model.descriptionDefault: Choose a model exposed by the selected provider.

autoStyle.description: Nova picks the Style for you based on the foreground app (a mail app → Email, ChatGPT → Prompt, etc.). The active window is read the moment you dictate, then forgotten — nothing is stored.
autoStyle.blocklistTip: Comma-separated. These apps are never inspected (e.g. banking, password manager). Common password managers are already excluded by default.

prompts.title: Styles

selectedPrompt.title: Active style
selectedPrompt.description: Select a template for refining transcriptions or create a new one. Use ${output} inside the prompt text to reference the captured transcript.

prompts.ultraOnly: Creating and editing styles requires Nova Ultra.
prompts.promptInstructionsPlaceholder: Write the instructions to run after transcription. Example: Improve grammar and clarity for the following text: ${output}
prompts.promptTip: Tip: Use ${output} to insert the transcribed text in your prompt.
prompts.selectToEdit: Select a prompt above to view and edit its details.
prompts.createFirst: Click 'Create New Prompt' above to create your first post-processing prompt.

powerProfile.label: Power profile
powerProfile.sameOnAllTiers: The quality and speed of Intelligence privée — the fully local engine — are identical on every plan: Nova Free, Pro and Ultra. Your plan only changes access to Turbo, the online engine.

contextReading.title: Context reading
contextReading.description: Nova reads what's on screen — the email you're replying to, the conversation — to write a reply that fits the situation. Read at dictation time, then forgotten.
contextReading.enableDescription: Let Nova read the active window's text to ground its reply. Fast, and stays on your machine.
contextReading.visualDescription: When text isn't enough, Nova analyzes an image of the screen through the online engine to understand the situation.
contextReading.privacyNote: Apps in your privacy blocklist are never read — not even their content.

postProcessing.subtitle: What the AI writes, based on context.

history.title: History
history.empty: No transcriptions yet. Start recording to build your history!
history.deleteError: Failed to delete entry. Please try again.
history.retranscribeError: Failed to re-transcribe. Please try again.
history.transcriptionFailed: Transcription failed. You can re-transcribe using the retry icon.

logDirectory.title: Log Directory
logDirectory.description: Location where log files are stored

liveLogs.title: Live Logs
liveLogs.description: Stream application logs in real time to diagnose issues without opening the log file. Only logs emitted while this panel is open are shown; respects the Log Level setting above.
liveLogs.empty: Waiting for logs… Entries appear here as the app emits them.

updateChecks.label: Check for Updates
updateChecks.description: Automatically check for new versions of Nova

whatsNewPreview.title: Preview What's New
whatsNewPreview.description: Open the latest bundled release note without marking it as seen

soundTheme.label: Sound Theme
soundTheme.description: Choose a sound theme for recording start and stop feedback

historyLimit.title: History Limit
historyLimit.description: Maximum number of history entries to keep

recordingRetention.title: Auto-Delete Recordings
recordingRetention.description: Automatically delete old recordings to save space

alwaysOnMicrophone.label: Always-On Microphone
alwaysOnMicrophone.description: Keep microphone active for faster response

clamshellMicrophone.title: Clamshell Microphone
clamshellMicrophone.description: Microphone to use when laptop lid is closed

postProcessingToggle.label: Post Processing
postProcessingToggle.description: Enable AI-powered text refinement after transcription

appendTrailingSpace.label: Append Trailing Space
appendTrailingSpace.description: Add a space after pasted transcription

keyboardImplementation.title: Keyboard Implementation
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: Keyboard shortcuts were incompatible and reset to defaults

pasteDelay.title: Paste Delay (Before)
pasteDelay.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after copying text, before sending the paste keystroke. Increase if nothing gets pasted.

pasteDelayAfter.title: Paste Delay (After)
pasteDelayAfter.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after the paste keystroke, before restoring your previous clipboard. Increase if your old clipboard content is being pasted instead of the transcription.

recordingBuffer.title: Extra Recording Buffer
recordingBuffer.description: Extra time (in milliseconds) to keep recording after you release the key, to capture trailing audio. 0 = no extra buffer.

meetingCapture.title: Meeting capture test
meetingCapture.description: Checks whether this computer can capture the other participants of a meeting — the sound coming out of your speakers — in addition to your microphone. Click the button, then switch to your meeting window within 3 seconds — the test reads whichever app is in the foreground.
meetingCapture.privacy: Captures about 2 seconds from the meeting app in the foreground, only to measure a sound level. Nothing is recorded, transcribed or sent anywhere.

results.working: Works. Nova captured {{seconds}} s from {{process}}, peak level {{level}} %.
results.silent: The stream from {{process}} opened but only heard silence. Make sure someone was speaking during the test.
results.no_meeting_app: No meeting app in the foreground. Open your meeting, keep its window active, then run the test again.
results.unavailable: This computer cannot capture a single app's sound. Windows 10 version 2004 or newer is required.
results.no_audio: The stream opened but produced no sound. Check that the meeting is playing sound on this computer.
results.stream_error: The capture stopped before the end of the test.

whatsNewUpdates.label: Show What's New
whatsNewUpdates.description: Show release notes after Nova updates

appDataDirectory.title: App Data Directory
appDataDirectory.description: Location where Nova stores its data

debugMode.title: Debug mode
debugMode.description: Shows the Diagnostics section in the sidebar, with technical tools such as live logs and diagnostic tests. You can also toggle it anytime with Ctrl+Shift+D.

sourceCode.title: Official website
sourceCode.description: Discover Nova and manage your subscription

ggml.title: ggml
ggml.description: High-performance tensor library for on-device machine learning inference
ggml.details: Nova's local speech-to-text is built on transcribe.cpp and ggml. Thanks to the amazing work by Georgi Gerganov and contributors.

home.subtitle: An overview of your Nova usage.

footer.portableUpdateMessage: Portable installs cannot be updated automatically. To update: download the latest NSIS installer from GitHub Releases, install it to the same folder, then copy your Data/ folder (settings, models, recordings) from the old version to the new one.

accessibility.permissionsDescription: Nova needs accessibility permissions to type transcribed text.

quota.blockedInline: Daily limit reached — dictation stays unlimited, your text is pasted as-is. Upgrade for unlimited rewrites.
quota.blockedDescription: You've used your 10 free rewrites for today. Dictation stays unlimited — your text is pasted as-is. Upgrade to Nova for unlimited rewrites.

errors.cpuOnlyMode: Your graphics driver hung Nova's engine on a previous launch, so transcription now runs on the CPU — slower, but working. Update your graphics driver, then re-enable the GPU in Settings → Configuration → Advanced.

micPermissionDenied.generic: Microphone access was denied by the operating system. Please grant microphone permission in your system settings.
micPermissionDenied.windows: Enable microphone access in Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone (including desktop app access).
micPermissionDenied.macos: Grant microphone access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
micPermissionDenied.linux: Grant microphone access in your system's sound or privacy settings.

errors.noInputDevice: No audio input device was detected. Please connect a microphone or headset and try again.
errors.pasteFailed: The text couldn't be pasted automatically. It's on your clipboard: paste it with Ctrl+V. If this keeps happening, check that your dictation shortcut doesn't overlap Ctrl+V.
errors.postProcessTimeout: The AI took too long — your raw text was pasted instead.
errors.microphoneNotFound: "{name}" is unavailable — the default microphone is used instead.

appLanguage.title: Application Language
appLanguage.description: Change the language of the Nova interface

theme.title: Application Theme
theme.description: Choose whether Nova follows your system theme or stays light or dark

overlay.styleSuggestion: You often dictate in {{app}} — try the {{style}} Style

performanceOptimizer.title: Automatic optimization
performanceOptimizer.description: Tune Nova for this computer and inspect the real transcription pipeline.
performanceOptimizer.autoDescription: Chooses safe acceleration and model memory settings from your RAM, CPU, and compatible GPUs.
performanceOptimizer.diagnosticsDescription: Check the microphone, model, rewrite provider, memory, and acceleration.

voiceCommands.title: Voice commands
voiceCommands.description: Understands new paragraph, new line, question mark, and explicit Nova commands for notes, lists, meetings, or cancelling the current dictation.
voiceCommands.added: {{word}} was added to the personal dictionary

trial.title: Nova Pro trial
trial.expiredTitle: Your Nova Pro trial has ended
trial.expiredBody: You're back on the Nova Free tier. Subscribe to Nova Pro to get the full Styles and power profiles back.
trial.toastDescription_one: {{count}} day left — Turbo and all Styles included.
trial.toastDescription_other: {{count}} days left — Turbo and all Styles included.

license.onlineEngineLocked: The online engine is reserved for Nova Pro and Ultra — your text was pasted without reformulation.

lexiconLearning.title: Learn my vocabulary
lexiconLearning.description: When Nova notices a name or term you dictate often, it suggests adding it to your personal lexicon. Nothing is ever added without your confirmation.
lexiconLearning.suggestionDescription: Add it to your personal lexicon to improve how Nova recognises it.

meeting.title: Meeting mode
meeting.description: Turn a meeting into a written report. Nova captures your microphone and the other participants' sound, then produces a summary that separates what you said from what they said.
meeting.capturingHint: Nova is recording this meeting. Finish to get the report.
meeting.reportEmpty: Nothing was captured — no one was heard during the meeting.

consent.title: Before you start
consent.subtitle: This concerns the other people in your meeting.
consent.body: Once started, Nova also records the other participants' voices — not only yours — while the detected meeting app is in the foreground. Depending on where you are, the law may require you to tell them first. Nova cannot do this for you.
consent.checkbox: I will let the other participants know before each captured meeting.

errors.no_meeting_app: No meeting app in the foreground. Open your meeting, keep its window active, then start again.
errors.already_running: A meeting is already being captured.
errors.no_active_meeting: No meeting is currently being captured.
errors.unavailable: This computer cannot capture a single app's sound. Windows 10 version 2004 or newer is required.
errors.no_audio: The stream opened but produced no sound. Check that the meeting is playing sound on this computer.
errors.internal: The meeting could not be started.

meeting.noApp: No meeting app detected. Open your meeting (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet…), then refresh.
